Term1: Tetanus, diphtheria and acellular pertussis vaccine Information
Text:
## Vaccine route, orders, names
## __________________________
## Route: IM (Td and Tdap)
## Outpatient orders:
[Td/Tdap 3 dose series](orz-set-abx-op-td-tdap-vaccine-3-dose-series)
Booster doses
[Td](orz-set-abx-op-tetanus-diphtheria-vaccine-one-dose)
[Tdap](orz-set-abx-op-tetanus-diphtheria-pertussis-vaccine-one-dose)
## CPRS names:
TETANUS/DIPHTERIA VACCINE
INJ (Td)
DIPHTHERIA/TETANUS/
PERTUSSIS VACCINE INJ,SUSP
(Tdap)
## Stocked brand name:
Tenivac (Td)
Boostrix (Tdap)
## Other names:
Tetanus, diphtheria and
acellular pertussis
(Td, Tdap)
References:
Immunization Action
Coalition,
Summary of Adult
Immunizations, 2021, P2011
Freedman et al., Annals of
internal medicine, 2021,
174(3)374-384.
<!-- COLUMN 2 -->
## Recommended populations
## __________________________
*All people who lack
written documentation of a
primary series consisting
of at least 3 doses of
tetanus- and diphtheria-
toxoid-containing vaccine.
*A booster dose of Td or
Tdap may be needed for
wound management, so
consult ACIP
recommendations.
*Adults who have not
received Td or Tdap in the
past 10 years or whose
Tdap history is not known.
<!-- COLUMN 3 -->
## Administration Schedule
## __________________________
*For people who are
unvaccinated or behind,
complete a 3-dose series
with Tdap as the first
dose, followed by Td or
Tdap (observe intervals of
1-2m between dose #1 and
#2, and an interval of 6-
12m between dose #2 and
#3).
*Give Tdap to pregnant
women during each
pregnancy (preferred
during the early part of
gestational weeks 27
through 36), regardless of
the interval since prior
Td or Tdap.
*Give Td or Tdap booster
every 10yrs after the
primary series has been
completed.
*If Tdap is indicated,
Tdap should be given
regardless of interval
since previous Td.
<!-- COLUMN 4 -->
## Contraindications/Precautions
## __________________________
## Contraindications
*History of severe
allergic reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to a previous
dose or to a vaccine
component.
*For Tdap only, history of
encephalopathy not
attributable to an
identifiable cause, within
7d following DTP/DTaP, or
Tdap.
## Precautions
*Moderate or severe acute
illness with or without
fever.
*History of Guillain-Barre
syndrome within 6wks
following previous dose of
tetanus-toxoid containing
vaccine.
*History of Arthus-type
reaction following a prior
dose of tetanus or
diphtheria-toxoid
containing vaccine
(including MenACWY): defer
vaccination until at least
10yrs have elapsed since
the last tetanus toxoid-
containing vaccine.
*For pertussis-containing
vaccines only, progressive
or unstable neurologic
disorder, uncontrolled
seizures, or progressive
encephalopathy until a
treatment regimen has been
established and the
condition has stabilized.
